title: review: B6: review and challenge worktrees base on the reviewed task's branch; scoped_diff against the parent goal branch; review affinity on account A
spec:
Why: review T-0026 judged B2 in a worktree created from origin/main (spawn.ensure_worktree default base), so it saw executor.py without B1's pool.py and reported the new API as nonexistent; every finding was an artefact. Also scoped_diff (spawn.py) diffs origin/main...HEAD, so stacked tasks show their predecessors' changes as their own. And .orchestrator/pool.toml gives review affinity only to account B, so a fallback task executed on B is reviewed on the same account. Depends on B2 merged into goal/T-0005 (spawn.py is edited by both).

What (≤4 files: orchestrator/spawn.py, .orchestrator/pool.toml, tests/test_orchestrator.py, README.md):
1. spawn.py — `def base_for(task) -> str`: for role review/challenge with inputs[0] a task id whose json has a worktree or branch, return `task/<inputs[0]>` if that branch exists, else `goal/<parent>` if it exists, else origin/main; for execute tasks with a parent whose `goal/<parent>` branch exists, return that goal branch (so the Planner no longer has to pre-create worktrees); otherwise origin/main. ensure_worktree(task_id, base=None) resolves base via base_for when not given. scoped_diff: diff base = `goal/<parent>` of the reviewed task when that branch exists, else origin/main; use `<base>...HEAD`.
2. pool.toml — add "review" to account A's role_affinity so Pool.pick("review") can land on either account; in Pool.pick for role review, skip the account that executed inputs[0] (read the reviewed task's `account` field) when another account has headroom. (Edit pool.py only for that skip; it is in scope for this one change.)
3. tests: base_for returns task/<id> for a review task whose input task branch exists (create branches in the TMP repo used by MergeQueue tests or a fresh scratch repo); returns goal/<parent> for an execute task with an existing goal branch; falls back to origin/main. Pool.pick("review") avoids the executing account when B is the executor and A has headroom.
4. README: one sentence under Access model or Phase 1: review worktrees are based on the reviewed task's branch; reviews prefer the other account.

Run `uv run python -m unittest tests/test_orchestrator.py`. Commit: "spawn: review/challenge worktrees base on the reviewed branch, diffs against the goal branch; reviews prefer the other account" with a revert-path body.
acceptance: uv run python -m unittest tests/test_orchestrator.py exits 0 with the new base_for and pick(review) tests
base_for(review task with inputs [T-x]) == 'task/T-x' when that branch exists
scoped_diff of a stacked task no longer includes its predecessor's hunks (test with two commits on a scratch repo)
pool.toml account A role_affinity contains review
git diff --stat limited to orchestrator/spawn.py, orchestrator/pool.py, .orchestrator/pool.toml, tests/test_orchestrator.py, README.md
